name: @agentage/memory-core
description: Markdown memory engine for AI agents: read, write, search and version notes in a git-backed vault. One storage-agnostic contract, a bare-git store, a multi-vault container and an @vault/path router - the local engine behind agentage Memory and @agentage/server-memory.
author: Agentage

scripts.verify: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run smoke:dist
scripts.smoke:dist: node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('./dist/index.js'); const k = await import('./dist/conformance/index.js'); if (typeof k.contractSuite !== 'function' || !Array.isArray(k.HOSTILE_PATHS)) process.exit(1); if (typeof m.ObjectCache !== 'function' || typeof m.createVaultContainer !== 'function' || typeof m.createRouter !== 'function') process.exit(1); if (m.unknownVaultMessage('x') !== 'Unknown vault \"@x\". Use memory__list with no folder to see available vaults.') process.exit(1); const c = new m.ObjectCache({ max: 1 }); const o = c.get('a', () => ({})); if (c.get('a', () => ({})) !== o || c.size !== 1 || !c.has('a')) process.exit(1); if (m.vaultRepoDir('/data', 'alice01', 'main') !== '/data/alice01/main.git' || m.REPO_SUFFIX !== '.git') process.exit(1); try { m.vaultRepoDir('/data', 'alice01', '../escape'); process.exit(1); } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'invalid_path') process.exit(1); } const gone = await m.checkRoot('/definitely/not/here', { markerFile: '.volume' }); if (gone.reachable !== false || gone.writable !== false || gone.markerPresent !== false || gone.diskTotalBytes !== 0) process.exit(1); const here = await m.checkRoot(process.cwd()); if (here.reachable !== true || here.markerPresent !== null || !(here.diskFreeBytes > 0) || here.diskFreeBytes > here.diskTotalBytes) process.exit(1); const s = m.createMemoryStore(); if ((await s.authors()).length !== 0) process.exit(1); await s.write({ path: 'a.md', body: 'x' }, { id: 'cli', name: 'CLI' }); await s.write({ path: 'b.md', body: 'y' }); const [who, ...rest] = await s.authors(); if (rest.length || who.author.id !== 'cli' || who.author.name !== 'CLI' || who.writes !== 1 || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(who.lastAt))) process.exit(1); console.log('dist smoke ok');"
